description: This file defines the TunerAdministrator class, a singleton responsible for managing tuner instances and notifications within the WPEFramework's Broadcast namespace. It includes mechanisms for registering, unregistering, announcing, and revoking tuner objects, as well as handling state changes and observer notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing tuner instances and observer notifications, providing registration, deregistration, announcement, revocation, and state change handling.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to receive tuner state change notifications.

classes.name: TunerAdministrator::Sink
classes.description: Internal class implementing ICallback, used to relay state changes to the parent TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TunerAdministrator.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer for tuner notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from tuner notifications.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a new tuner object and returns a callback interface for state change notifications.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a previously announced tuner object.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles a state change notification for a specific tuner.
